content_read_through: Replica propagates legitimate updates and logical deletion; backup restores historical data, not automatically latest business facts.
Controlled write block + refresh make six-document baseline deterministic; not a mandatory production snapshot pause. Snapshot shard views span start/end interval.
Shared fs content/path/whitelist/filesystem permissions; same-host repository volume is not physical disaster recovery; API deletion only, no manual segment-file edits.
Accepted is not terminal; metadata vs status endpoint semantics; failures and successful shard counts independently checked; no capture of transient IN_PROGRESS claimed.
Missing risk primary, PARTIAL, returned original node does not repair old snapshot, default restore rejection, opt-in EMPTY_STORE loss demonstration; HTTP200 failed1 cannot pass complete restore.
Open-name conflict; anchored rename; exclude global/feature state and aliases; restored index retains snapshot write block; wait for replicas and inspect full data/query before read alias switch.
Same application process; operational APIs stay out of visitor interface; source retains five current docs; historical 6000 vs legitimate 6500 requires business reconciliation beyond F34.
Exact cleanup and original volumes; repeat formal runs; failed pre-runs segregated; F35 remains unimplemented.
